description: Read-only Windows host evidence collection for authorized incident response. Stores Run Command output in S3 and creates a SHA-256 integrity manifest.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes for preflight, command execution, and manifest creation.

InstanceId.description: Authorized EC2 instance ID to investigate.

IncidentId.description: Incident correlation identifier used in evidence prefixes and manifests.

EvidenceBucket.description: S3 bucket receiving Run Command stdout/stderr and the integrity manifest.

EvidencePrefix.description: Top-level S3 prefix. Keep it free of secrets and customer data.

commands:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
function Section([string]$Name) { Write-Output "`n===== $Name =====" }

Section "collection_header"
Write-Output ("collection_time_utc=" + [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString("o"))
Write-Output "instance_id={{InstanceId}}"
Write-Output "incident_id={{IncidentId}}"
Write-Output "automation_execution_id={{automation:EXECUTION_ID}}"
Write-Output ("computer_name=" + $env:COMPUTERNAME)

Section "operating_system"
Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,BuildNumber,OSArchitecture,LastBootUpTime | Format-List
Get-ComputerInfo -Property WindowsProductName,WindowsVersion,OsBuildNumber,OsArchitecture,CsDomain,CsPartOfDomain | Format-List

Section "processes"
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CreationDate | Sort-Object ProcessId | Format-Table -AutoSize

Section "network_addresses_routes"
Get-NetIPAddress | Sort-Object InterfaceIndex,AddressFamily | Format-Table -AutoSize
Get-NetRoute | Sort-Object InterfaceIndex,DestinationPrefix | Format-Table -AutoSize
Get-NetTCPConnection | Sort-Object State,LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize

Section "services"
Get-Service | Sort-Object Status,Name | Format-Table Status,Name,DisplayName -AutoSize

Section "packages_and_updates"
Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn | Format-Table -AutoSize
$UninstallRoots = @(
  'HKLM:\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall\\*',
  'HKLM:\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall\\*'
)
Get-ItemProperty $UninstallRoots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object DisplayName |
  Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher,InstallDate |
  Sort-Object DisplayName |
  Format-Table -AutoSize

Section "users_and_logons"
Get-LocalUser | Select-Object Name,Enabled,LastLogon,PasswordLastSet,SID | Format-Table -AutoSize
whoami /all
quser 2>&1

Section "scheduled_tasks"
Get-ScheduledTask | Select-Object TaskPath,TaskName,State,Author | Sort-Object TaskPath,TaskName | Format-Table -AutoSize

Section "selected_event_logs"
$Start = (Get-Date).AddHours(-24)
foreach ($LogName in @('System','Application','Security')) {
  Write-Output "--- $LogName ---"
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName=$LogName; StartTime=$Start} -MaxEvents 750 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,LevelDisplayName,ProviderName,Message |
    Format-List
}

Section "collection_footer"
Write-Output ("collection_end_utc=" + [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString("o"))

inputs.Script:
def build_manifest(events, context):
    import boto3
    import hashlib
    import json
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    bucket = events["bucket"]
    prefix = events["prefix"].rstrip("/") + "/"
    s3 = boto3.client("s3")

    paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    objects = []
    for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=prefix):
        for item in page.get("Contents", []):
            key = item["Key"]
            if key.endswith("/integrity-manifest.json"):
                continue
            response = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            body = response["Body"]
            while True:
                chunk = body.read(1024 * 1024)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digest.update(chunk)
            objects.append({
                "key": key,
                "size": int(response.get("ContentLength", item.get("Size", 0))),
                "etag": str(response.get("ETag", "")).strip('"'),
                "version_id": response.get("VersionId", ""),
                "last_modified": response.get("LastModified", item.get("LastModified")).isoformat(),
                "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
            })

    objects.sort(key=lambda value: value["key"])
    canonical_index = json.dumps(objects, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    manifest = {
        "schema": "aws-ir-evidence-manifest/v1",
        "incident_id": events["incident_id"],
        "instance_id": events["instance_id"],
        "platform": events["platform"],
        "automation_execution_id": events["execution_id"],
        "run_command_id": events["command_id"],
        "collection_completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "s3_bucket": bucket,
        "s3_prefix": prefix,
        "evidence_object_count": len(objects),
        "evidence_index_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical_index).hexdigest(),
        "objects": objects,
    }
    manifest_key = prefix + "integrity-manifest.json"
    s3.put_object(
        Bucket=bucket,
        Key=manifest_key,
        Body=(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\\n").encode("utf-8"),
        ContentType="application/json",
    )
    return {
        "manifest_uri": f"s3://{bucket}/{manifest_key}",
        "object_count": str(len(objects)),
        "evidence_index_sha256": manifest["evidence_index_sha256"],
    }
